description: Public no-choice structured comprehension vocabulary and response schema.
set_semantics: All four array fields are unordered unique atomic sets. Empty sets are allowed only when the case requires no atom in that field.

next_action.operational_meaning: Enter final appraisal and closeout after the last construction item is proven.
Produce the terminal handoff strictly from post-gate evidence, including archive, commits, proof, appraisal, risks, and repository state.
Mark the completed item and revise later ordering or scope when new evidence changes the best path.
Maintain a preliminary discussion ledger; do not enter construction.
Perform every missing closeout gate; if one truly fails, report that exact gate and required user action.
Repair each authorized in-scope fix finding, rerun relevant proof, and repeat fresh derived-scope appraisal to closure.
Continue the sanctioned canonical ledger at its earliest pending implementation item.
Relocate the readable execution ledger into its dated permanent directory only after final appraisal closes.
Reopen the entire ledger and resume the discovered pending in-scope item.
Assign the single bounded construction unit to one worker; use direct execution only if none is available.
Create an appropriately named feature revision before producing durable material.
Inspect repository state and suspend before writing if unrelated edits intersect the intended surface.
Complete enabled auxiliary passes and refinement, then present the ledger for human acceptance.
Commit the permanent move together with all remaining appraisal, cleanup, construction, and proof edits.
Rescan the entire sanctioned ledger and immediately take its earliest pending item.
Perform the earliest pending stage in the prescribed end-to-end sequence.
Use the normal visible Chrome ChatGPT Pro surface with curated safe repository context.
Run the protocol-derived targeted or full repair appraisal after authorized fixes.
Run another fresh whole-ledger refinement pass after every material edit until one pass is clean.
Revise the existing preliminary ledger and remain in discussion state.
Execute every required prompt sequentially in one uninterrupted round while the main agent owns disposition and repairs.
Run finalization immediately before any terminal-sounding response.
Delete the withdrawn scope and retain only a brief safeguard against accidental reintroduction when useful.
Perform local reconnaissance plus live web investigation, persist the memo, apply adopted findings, and summarize.
Load architectural guidance and maintain the repository boundary document when the change affects ownership.
Keep the permanent ledger readable and remove disposable step or risk-free appraisal material when allowed.
Invoke the bounded adversarial appraisal and return without constructing anything.
Inspect local construction and proof conventions, then prepare a bounded packet for substantial work.
Apply deep-research results first, Pro-analysis results second, and refine afterward.
State competing explanations and run the smallest deterministic discriminator before choosing a repair.
Run one fresh whole-diff final appraisal using the execution ledger as scope.
Commit the useful bounded result without absorbing unrelated edits or creating an empty commit.
Enter Deliver processing even though the request omitted a slash-style invocation.
Classify the failure layer, then gather the smallest discriminating observation before another patch.
Transcribe the fixed outside scope into the canonical ledger, then execute from that ledger.
Retain the currently checked-out non-base revision line.
Do not enter or preserve retired draft-discussion behavior; continue through a currently supported planning or execution route.

required_artifact.operational_meaning: Capture the initial repository-change baseline used by the terminal gate.
Produce and validate the structured correction-boundary artifact.
Produce the adaptive-loop launch specification with entry criteria, exit criteria, and invocation.
Relocate the legible execution ledger into its timestamped permanent directory.
Relocate the visual-intent prototype beside the stored ledger under its stable filename.
Persist the governing execution ledger in its prescribed Markdown location.
Persist the external-research dossier ending with the prescribed substantiation declaration.
Persist the premium-analysis reconciliation ledger before plan cleanup.
Persist the terminal appraisal journal through the finish gate.
Persist the contained implementation brief for the current item.
Persist the lightweight standalone visual-intent prototype.
Create no draft-only plan artifact or notice; use the normal canonical execution-plan artifact when the supported workflow calls for one.

required_check.operational_meaning: Confirm the refined ledger has shallow phases, its execution notice, and a direct acceptance request.
Choose no-test when stronger lasting coverage already protects the same boundary.
Accept a fixed remediation packet only with unchanged-diff provenance, complete profile, fresh critic, and authorized boundary.
Require the repair record validator before starting and again before completing the repair appraisal.
Require a linked lightweight visual-intent prototype before acceptance of frontend scope.
Use ordinary planning when decisive evidence is costly, scheduled, permission-gated, or nonrepeatable.
Exercise the changed rendered surface in its real interface and preserve visual evidence.
Require a fresh critic to challenge scope, order, dependencies, duplication, ambiguity, and oversized slices.
Compare current repository status with the saved initial dirty-state snapshot and reject new uncommitted run work.
Confirm the preliminary ledger has its required notice, request for inspection, and checklist form.
Require the worker packet to state boundary, context, proof, UI need, test disposition, no-commit rule, and return evidence.
Require a complete round log, every applicable prompt, resolved material items, quality check, and passing or justified tests.
Escalate repair appraisal to full when architecture, trust, concurrency, isolation, contract, security, or data risk demands it.
Run the narrow proof that directly substantiates the completed bounded item.
Choose a table case when related inputs share boundary, expected result, and failure mechanism.
Keep the ledger high-level and put item-level mechanics in the bounded step packet.
Confirm every Deliver deliverable uses its prescribed repository location.
Classify artificial depth, size, recursion, interpreter, or resource-limit reproduction as probe-only by default.
Require targeted repair scope to include finding IDs, diff boundary, adjacent callers, prompts, reruns, and fresh closure.
Assign and record one permanent, table-case, probe-only, or no-test disposition with evidence.
Reduce the preliminary ledger to short phases, shallow boxes, and useful unresolved questions.
Record evidence-tied agent-loop process findings without letting process commentary independently block completion.
Exercise accepted-looking parser inputs against downstream grammar, including malformed and base-sensitive numeric states.
Choose a standalone lasting regression for one uniquely uncovered supported boundary.
Keep chosen outcomes and constraints while removing justification prose, nesting, and deferred meta-work.
Maintain one readable execution ledger instead of the retired multi-document planning stack.
Use the short Codex profile for GPT-family critics and the full profile for other critics.
Use adaptive-goal form only for a repeatable inspect-change-measure loop with a meaningful comparator.
Require a complete final-appraisal log with no unresolved unchecked or material item before terminal handoff.
Require real-state visual and interaction evidence across changed screens, states, breakpoints, controls, and accessibility.
Challenge bugs, smaller deltas, and falsifiers, then rebut the findings before declaring clean.
Audit failure handling, secrets, destructive safeguards, rollback, performance, dependencies, security, monitoring, and go-live risk.
Omit routine status, result, commit, and transcript bookkeeping from the ledger.
Require every material finding to carry the complete severity, gate, disposition, evidence, impact, and fix shape.
Validate effect vocabulary, contract-change flag consistency, uncertainty isolation, and derived scope.
Exercise readiness completion, simultaneous waiters, ownership loss, stale recovery, and foreground defaults.
Match reasoning effort to role: strongest for research/blockers, strong for judgment/coding, standard for mechanics.
Keep a disposable historical-fixture reproduction as a one-run probe without inventing a harness.
Require executed end-to-end proof of the original outcome plus explicit assumptions, skips, risks, and destructive-path safety.
Classify UI and production-readiness prompts from the changed surfaces, with reasons for non-applicability.
Derive the ledger from supplied material after inspecting repository-specific constraints.
Verify and repair an in-scope defect independently of whether its reproduction becomes lasting coverage.
Require main-point-first, short, concrete, full-sentence language with only decision-relevant detail.
Consult the design guide and surface the unresolved product choice instead of inventing it.
Confirm the coordinator retains selection, integration, proof judgment, ledger updates, and commits.
Reject the invocation because its modifier set falls outside the supported trio.
Keep lasting coverage only when it is supported, material, unique, deterministic, stable, and economical.
Confirm the retired draft-discussion mode, legacy discuss alias, draft-only plan shape, and draft-only stop boundary are absent.

stop_condition.operational_meaning: Continue repairing incomplete web investigation; suspend only for unavailable access, unsafe exposure, a required decision, or explicit removal.
Hold closing appraisal when required environment or interaction evidence cannot be obtained.
Suspend after the eighth refinement round if any material planning defect remains.
Suspend with a brief link after updating the preliminary discussion ledger; await an explicit refine or execute request.
Suspend with the genuine final-appraisal blocker and make no completion claim.
Hold for sponsor direction when the unresolved product choice changes the route.
Rescan the entire sanctioned ledger and immediately take its earliest pending item.
Suspend accelerated execution at any unsafe, irreversible, unavailable, ambiguous, incomplete, or approval-gated boundary.
Hold closing appraisal while a material security or release-safety risk remains unresolved.
Hold closing appraisal while required end-to-end verification remains blocked.
Suspend for a human repair decision and preserve residual risk for the terminal handoff.
Suspend transmission and request direction when the proposed context is unsafe or excessively broad.
Suspend and request direction when no named revision is attached or unrelated edits cannot travel safely.
Suspend active construction only for a required decision, unavailable dependency, unsafe action, material contradiction, or proof blocker.
Block refinement while Pro analysis is degraded or incomplete unless the requester explicitly removes that gate.
Suspend after producing the adaptive goal document and launch prompt until the requester explicitly starts goal mode.
Do not put an adaptive-goal document through ordinary Deliver closeout without explicit conversion.
Do not stop at the retired draft-discussion boundary; stop only at a current normal blocker or approval boundary.

user_approval.operational_meaning: No new user approval is required at this workflow moment.
Do not perform the unsafe or destructive action without explicit approval.
Existing approval of the fixed plan or packet authorizes the bounded next step.
Pause and request the user decision needed to choose a safe path.
